method: Owner-signed fast-forward main, matching Validate content CI, exact ZIP/runtime equality.
reviewIdentity: Claude claude-sonnet-5.5, GPT gpt-6.1-sol and Grok grok-4.7 each CONFIRMED reviewed snapshot 24201899; signed merge 684d754c integrates origin/main 2bc61140, which changed no runtime path; the signed closure 5aa7f593 adds documents only and fast-forwards origin/main 2bc61140
limits: No Kotlin reading cross-check or Android JVM tests (no JDK on the continuation machine); no native, rendered-font, device or phone check. Phone acceptance is outstanding.

Rounds r2-r5 were GPT-family only: no model was requested, the session's gpt-6-luna was inherited (r2's start event logged gpt-6.2-astra, but every r2 response came from gpt-6-luna), and each round ran its three facets in parallel. They do not meet the three-family rule; the sequential Claude, GPT and Grok confirmations c1 and c2 do.

The five pre-merge fix commits (the r1-r5 fixes) were re-signed with the registered key after the r2-r5 rounds and before the merge; trees are identical. The SHAs the r2-r5 reviewers saw (77ff93d9, 77f56733, 4bf9db0c, f811f8eb) and the original r5 fix 970bb0dc, which no reviewer saw as a snapshot, exist only on an unpushed local branch; the closure records the mapping to 2798cfbc, c8937669, 967b8603, e2ef32e5 and f1a69909.
The r1 GPT and Grok reports do not name their model; the actual models come from the session events.

Several runs had overlapping or recursive commands (see scope-audits in the closure). Some reports were recovered from the runs' final messages because no report file was written; GPT wrote neither its c1 nor its c2 report file.

r1 Claude's report file (8,908 characters) is longer than its archived final message (6,209 characters); both carry the same ten findings, and the extra details are covered by the current exclusions and cards.
c1 GPT used whole-file reads; c1 Claude claimed one call at a time but had two in flight; c1 Grok listed the reports folder.
c2 Claude's first pass was shallow and needed one follow-up prompt; it made six overlapping starts and deleted and recreated its report.

c2 Grok ran one grep without a path that searched the author's workspace copy of Words.kt; it saw only a three-line preview, disclosed it, and did not use it as evidence. Its five outside-path scope-audit flags are false positives (packet paths passed as JSON lists).
The c1 fix 81142e4a introduced a generic 男 distractor on 侍; 0daebfba replaced it with 雨 before c2.
The legacy quiz selection of the reused cards 助 and 理 is unchanged; all three c2 reviewers accepted the decline.
The author's confirmation-packet builder (outside the repository) had a bug that was fixed before c2.
Rejecting 女 as a 侍 distractor was a precaution: JMdict 1344370 lists 女 only as a search-only form.

The author's c2 response miscounted the source-only reading labels on other cards (said 97 cards, 43 on; actually 98 cards, 70 kun, 44 on, 16 with both, plus 潜 and 狭 with other phrasing). Reviewer-facing only; raised by c2 Grok.
Optional polish not applied: 倫.md line 34 repeats itself and line 38 is a little formal.

4 latent reading collisions are not drawable in the checked N1, All and Starter pools (佳 けい and えい, 侍 かみ, 俗 しょく). Sampled seeds are not exhaustive. The reading audits are the author's Python ports of the Kotlin builder, kept outside the repository.

Lint reports 1 error and 44 warnings, all on pre-existing reused files: the error is the unknown phonetic key in kanji/語.md, which is older than the batch (the batch only adds a link line to 語). None is on the ten new cards or the ten new articles.

The 諸侯 support word is the batch's only untagged exception (JMdict 1344250); no 侯 spelling qualifies (侯, 侯爵 and 王侯 carry only news2 and spec2; 侯補 is a search-only spelling of 候補). The c1 Claude, GPT and Grok reviewers found the row-specific justification sufficient; owner acceptance of the exception is not recorded.

Closure storage: confirmation packets are deduplicated by content (provenance sameAs) and round packets r2-r5 are stored as per-round deltas. A dedupe check of the 356 stored or referenced confirmation and round-packet files (snapshot copies excluded) found 0 errors; 72 round files were matched by hash to the initial manifest. The initial packet was not checked this way; rubric and title files are recorded by hash only.
A Grok reviewer was added to the Claude and GPT reviewers because the batch adds word articles, as for B156.
The gate results come from the author's runs included in the packets, not from reviewer reruns.
The runtime compacted the context once in r1-grok, c1-claude, c1-gpt and c1-grok; the other 17 runs were not compacted (local session log; provenance.json does not record compaction).
No published commit is rewritten; the five pre-merge fix commits were re-signed before the merge, and every run's final report is kept.
Every stored prompt equals, byte for byte, the first message recorded in its reviewer session (the c2 Claude follow-up equals that session's second message).
This exact published runtime and ZIP are verified, not the remaining N1 set.
A later contributor-only receipt commit needs its own CI and exported-tree equality check.
